title: LocalFind Phase-0 relevance judgments
description: Annotated queries for retrieval evaluation (PLAN.md section 9). A query may list several relevant assets/segments; negative queries list none. Grades: 2 = highly relevant, 1 = partially relevant.

version.description: Bump together with the corpus manifest when judgments change.

corpus_id.description: Must equal the corpus manifest's corpus_id.

query_id.description: Stable ID, unique in the set, e.g. 'q014'.

text.description: The literal query string fed to the retriever.

query_class.description: visual: natural-language visual description. exact_filename: identifier-shaped filename/path query (must work without inference). semantic_image: conceptual (non-literal) image query. negative: must return nothing (expected is empty).

modality.description: Which asset modality the query targets.

expected.description: Relevant assets. Empty if and only if query_class is 'negative'.

asset_id.description: Must reference an asset_id in the paired corpus manifest.

start_ms.description: REQUIRED for video expectations: relevant interval start. Forbidden for images.

end_ms.description: REQUIRED for video expectations: relevant interval end, start_ms < end_ms <= asset duration. Forbidden for images.

tolerance_ms.description: Timestamp slack the evaluator (P0-T007) allows around [start_ms, end_ms]. Informative here; enforced there.
